title: game/data/boons.json: boons and curses (perks track PK-9): named effects that last a few places, handed out by events (`boon <id>`, `curse <id>`) and the fountain's wish; while one is on its rows join the run's (logic/effects.js fxOfRun, src boon:<id>)

name.description: what the player reads; battle lines and the Perks tab name it

d.description: what it does while it lasts, in one sentence

curse.description: a curse (the Bureau's Red Tape): a clinic's appeal lifts it, Correction Fluid shortens or erases it; a boon when left out

places.description: how long it lasts: the place it is given in and this many more (0-20; each place walked into counts one down)

img.description: its picture, a 36 x 36 icon under game/art (tools/build-icons.mjs boons draws it; the Studio's icon editor edits it); without one it shows the relic icon

fx.description: its effect rows, as a Perk's (perks.schema.json)
